items.title: Sam Most interviewed by Monk Rowe, Los Angeles, California, February 15, 1999
items.q: even the bigger names like one you told me, Roger Kellaway

ctx.x: What was it like to get record labels to record you? Has it been hard over the years?

Well it was easy for me, I guess I was in my 20s, 22, 24, 22, 23, 24, just like the young lions today only maybe a little different. So I think with the help of my friend or I don’t know how it came about but I got an offer to do the four albums for Bethlehem, but recently it’s been very hard, from my conversations with other people, either you have to, even the bigger names like one you told me, Roger Kellaway, you have either putting up the money yourself or I’m not sure, but it’s been harder recently to do it.…
Yeah. It sounds beautiful off of the LP you know?
